purpose: Define the machine-readable report emitted by a Contract Format 1.4 conformance run, including implementation identity, profile, fixture versions, pass/fail evidence and unsupported optional capabilities.

topics.name: Conformance Report
topics.purpose: Define the machine-readable report emitted by a Contract Format 1.4 conformance run, including implementation identity, profile, fixture versions, pass/fail evidence and unsupported optional capabilities.

semantics.evidence_rule: Each failed test references fixture, violated gate and diagnostic evidence.
semantics.profile_rule: Conformance is always claimed against an explicit profile/version, never generically.
semantics.optional_rule: Unsupported optional capabilities are explicit and cannot masquerade as passed.
semantics.repro_rule: Report contains enough fixture/profile identity to reproduce the run.

invariants.rule: A Contract Format 1.4 conformance claim is backed by reproducible machine-readable fixtures, validation results and exact profile/version identity.

hard_gates.condition: run cannot be reproduced from declared suite/profile

prose.summary: Define the machine-readable report emitted by a Contract Format 1.4 conformance run, including implementation identity, profile, fixture versions, pass/fail evidence and unsupported optional capabilities.
notes: Unlocked pending implementation of executable conformance fixtures and whole-tree validation.
